+func TestCheckerTokenEvents(t *testing.T) {
+	testCases := []struct {
+		name       string
+		eventPairs []string
+		created    bool
+		deleted    bool
+	}{
+		{name: "creation only", eventPairs: []string{"token:created"}, created: true},
+		{name: "deletion only", eventPairs: []string{"token:deleted"}, deleted: true},
+		{name: "both explicit", eventPairs: []string{"token:created", "token:deleted"}, created: true, deleted: true},
+		{name: "all token actions", eventPairs: []string{"token:*"}, created: true, deleted: true},
+		{name: "all resources created", eventPairs: []string{"*:created"}, created: true},
+		{name: "all resources deleted", eventPairs: []string{"*:deleted"}, deleted: true},
+		{name: "all events", eventPairs: []string{"*:*"}, created: true, deleted: true},
+		{name: "unrelated resource", eventPairs: []string{"flag:*"}},
+		{name: "unrelated action", eventPairs: []string{"*:updated"}},
+	}
+
+	for _, tc := range testCases {
+		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			checker, err := NewChecker(tc.eventPairs)
+			if !assert.NoError(t, err) {
+				return
+			}
+
+			assert.Equal(t, tc.created, checker.Check("token:created"))
+			assert.Equal(t, tc.deleted, checker.Check("token:deleted"))
+		})
+	}
+}
